messages:
sam (eng-sre): Quick sync—postmortem is up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1827. TL;DR: KV-cache eviction cascade led to request amplification. I pulled out runbook gaps we should fix this week.

sam (eng-sre): Proposed action items: 1) Add explicit triage step to validate KV cache status + fallback toggle (owner: maria, due: 2025-05-09). 2) Add a reproducible 'safe-mode' command block to runbook for service-side throttling (owner: devon, due: 2025-05-12). 3) Update escalation path when autoscaler fails to spin (owner: ana, due: 2025-05-08). 4) Instrument recurring incident pattern into pager for 30d trend review (owner: sam, due: 2025-05-20).

maria (eng-platform): Ack. I'll take #1. Adding step to runbook to check cache hit ratio + TTLs. Will add remediation checklist.

devon (eng-runtime): Taking #2. Draft snippet below for safe-mode toggle—please review:

```
# safe-mode: limit incoming concurrent reqs to 10% of normal
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference annotate deployment/inference-api safe-mode=true
# flip cache to read-only
kubectl exec -it pod/inference-api-0 -- /bin/sh -c "export KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly && supervisorctl restart inference"
```

devon (eng-runtime): Also adding a small diagnostic that dumps KV sizes and recent eviction timestamps.

ana (typo fix)

ana (should be ana)(infra): small note—we should also include the telemetry query for cache eviction spikes so oncall can run it without paging into dashboards. I'll add the Grafana/Splunk query to the runbook.

maria (eng-platform): Where should the explicit escalation step point? Current runbook just says "eng-sre". Recommend: step 3 -> @oncall-sre -> @platform-pager if no ack in 5m -> page infra lead after 15m.

sam (eng-sre): That escalation ladder sounds good. Add it and I'll update the playbook PR.

devon (eng-runtime): Question: do we want an automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant when eviction cascade starts? That could be a separate action—flagging for Optimize team.

sam (eng-sre): Noted. I'll raise with Optimize, but keep runbook focused on triage + containment.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook edit created by maria: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-draft. PR #472.

maria (eng-platform): PR created, added checklist items + sample queries. tagging @ana for telemetry snippet.

ana (again typo)

ana -> ana (infra): added telemetry query in PR comments. Also included a simple `curl` to probe prefix cache fullness.

ana (err sorry for spam)

ana (infra): :thumbsup: all set from infra side. I'll also schedule a 30m runbook walkthrough on 2025-05-07 to make sure the oncall runbook steps are clear.

devon (eng-runtime): Added the diagnostics script and a small test harness to the PR. Recommend we include the exact `kubectl` output parse for quick triage.

sam (eng-sre): Great. Owners: maria, devon, ana. Timelines above—I'll create reminders and a follow-up thread for the walkthrough. If anyone needs to shift dates, ping here.

runbook-bot: Reminder set: runbook walkthru 2025-05-07 15:00 UTC (invite sent to participants).

maria (eng-platform): One more: add link to postmortem in the runbook header and tag the recurring incident pattern so it appears in the monthly incident digest.

sam (eng-sre): Done in PR. Closing this thread after walkthrough unless new issues. :thumbsup:
